spec_match.rationale: Implements the spec's update-capture-state step 1 (not fully active → promise rejected with InvalidStateError), mirrored by Chromium media_session.cc's IsActive() check; calls the real methods on a removed iframe's retained MediaSession and brand-checks the cross-realm promise.

interactive.rationale: Four step buttons (create, call attached, remove, call detached) plus reset, each calling the real API and rendering outcomes.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The feature-index card describes exactly what the page does; no permission is required, as promised.

edge_cases.rationale: Distinguishes spec rejection, legacy silent undefined, synchronous throw and still-pending; calls out the cross-realm instanceof Promise gotcha.

references.rationale: Links the chromestatus entry, the W3C spec section and related MDN/WebIDL/WPT references.

conformance.rationale: Feature suite (9 assertions) mirrors the IDL contract: 3 pass / 6 fail on Chromium 153, 9/9 under the 159 emulation harness — every behavioural assertion can fail.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chrome for Testing 153.0.8010.12 via Playwright (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this environment), desktop 1280x800 and mobile 360x740 DPR3 touch; plus a scratchpad-only init-script harness emulating the 159 Promise<undefined> signature to exercise the promise branches (not counted as real 159 evidence). The real Chrome 159 promise path could not be executed here.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts detached-session-invalidstate with per-call outcomes; true only for the spec rejection or the documented legacy undefined.

design_system.rationale: Only design-system CSS variables; verdict colours are --accent-emerald-dark / --accent-rose on light surfaces (AA).

accessibility.rationale: Ordered steps with headings, native buttons enabled/disabled in sequence with focus moved to the next action, results in status regions, iframe has a title.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: No page-level horizontal overflow and no control under 44px at 360x740 DPR3 or 1280x800 after driving all controls; screenshots reviewed.

openQuestions.title: Capture the Promise<undefined> path on real Chrome 159+
openQuestions.detail: Only Chromium 153 (legacy) ran natively; the promise branch was exercised through a test-only emulation harness. Re-run on Chrome 159 Canary/Dev/Beta and confirm verdicts and telemetry asserts.

openQuestions.title: Inspect the accessibility tree with chrome-devtools-mcp
openQuestions.detail: chrome-devtools-mcp was unavailable (project rule 7b); names/roles were checked from DOM only.

openQuestions.title: Confirm real Chrome 159 rejection realm and settlement for a detached context
openQuestions.detail: Chromium throws InvalidStateError via ExceptionState in a promise-returning op; whether the rejected promise is created in the detached iframe realm and whether its reactions run must be confirmed on a real 159 build (the page reports 'pending' honestly if not).

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible status live region announcing async result
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use native buttons, role=status / aria-live=polite regions for asynchronous results, and visible focus.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: All controls are native <button>/<input>; results land in role=status or aria-live=polite regions; :focus-visible outlines use --accent-blue.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive grid of cards no horizontal overflow on mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use intrinsic/min() grid tracks and wrap flex rows so nothing overflows narrow viewports.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Control groups use repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 14rem), 1fr)) and flex-wrap; long code wraps with overflow-wrap:anywhere; 44px min tap targets.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: documentElement.scrollWidth <= innerWidth at 360x740 and 1280x800 for every page after driving all controls.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Removing an iframe from the DOM discards its browsing context; reparenting is the way to keep state.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Exception by design: the demo deliberately removes the iframe to make its document not fully active, which is exactly the spec precondition under test.

summary: Chromium 153: attached and detached calls both returned undefined → 'legacy behaviour' verdict. Emulated 159: attached calls fulfilled undefined, detached rejected InvalidStateError. Console clean.
